items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: there were four of us there -- Laurence Madison.

ctx.x: Well, look, what we've got to do now is we've got to get you from Jeff City to where you go from there.

Well, Jeff City, I'm still back in Webster Groves. I go back to Webster Groves to go home in summer naturally. I had And, fortunately/some things happen for me, nice things happen for me and I could take some weight off the family. See what I mean? I played the horn, you know. And, ... must be around 28 now, out of school for two years and make some money to keep things going. Going back to school. So, I got a job on the levee playing the horn and there were four of us there -- Laurence Madison.
